ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed up (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 11).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): buy zone. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: Confirmed cycle low — the entry window is open now, with a clear exit if it closes back below 239.11.

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 11 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: fresh — a new cycle just started
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 11 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 新的日线周期，第 11 天：摆动低点已现，价格重新站上 10 日均线，日线动量为正——且周线周期也一致确认。
ladder.next_zh: 按周期逻辑胜率最高的窗口；失效点 = 收盘跌破周期低点（239.11）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正；但正趋向周线向下交叉；3 日线向上交叉（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 11 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：买入区。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.macro_line: Macro-risk headwind: aggregate macro risk is elevated and this is a macro-sensitive (cyclical) name — buy setups here have historically taken deeper drawdowns, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. A risk/sizing caution, not a forecast.
ladder.macro_line_zh: 宏观风险逆风：总体宏观风险偏高，且该标的对宏观较敏感（周期性）——在此环境下买入形态历史上回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是风险/仓位提示，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ BUY ZONE signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-25), switching from UPTREND. Signal strength: strong (score +72/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 买入区信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-25），自上涨趋势切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 +72/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健买入形态（+46）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: armed at the lower gamma band — a close below releases a downside move
reasons.zh: 在下沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘跌破即向下释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +9.1 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +9.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

alignment.reason_zh: 已过热（超买／远高于200日均线）— 等待回调
alignment.line_zh: 周线周线上行 · 3日turn↑ · 日线—

reasoning: backed by a insider / earnings / revision edge
favourable forward cone (~18% up vs ~9% drawdown)

entry_signal.headline: Buy zone — entry open now
entry_signal.headline_zh: 买入区 — 入场窗口已开启
entry_signal.action: Confirmed cycle low — the entry window is open now, with a clear exit if it closes back below 239.11.
entry_signal.action_zh: 周期低点已确认——入场窗口现已开启，若收盘重新跌破 239.11 则明确离场。

timing.next_trigger: Confirmed cycle low — the entry window is open now, with a clear exit if it closes back below 239.11.

levels.label_en: 25% over the 200-day (out of the chase zone)
levels.label_zh: 高于200日均线25%（脱离追高区）

pullback_zone.headline_en: Don't chase the print — let it come back. Accumulate on a pullback into the zone below: the leader you want, at a non-chase price.
pullback_zone.headline_zh: 勿追当下价位 — 等它回落。回调进入下方区间时分批建仓：你想要的领涨股，以非追高价位。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.34 ± 0.31 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLI) reads duration-neutral (+0.01). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.34 ± 0.31——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLI）为久期中性（+0.01）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

caveat.en: Public-record alt-data convergence — the unusual-activity layer. Graded vs SPY in the Signal Intelligence ledger; weight by that track record, not a standalone trade signal.
caveat.zh: 公开记录替代数据汇聚——异常活动层。在信号情报战绩中对标普评分；据该战绩权衡，而非独立交易信号。

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: Confirmed cycle low — the entry window is open now, with a clear exit if it closes back below 239.11.
timing.text_zh: 周期低点已确认——入场窗口现已开启，若收盘重新跌破 239.11 则明确离场。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Reshoring & Industrial Capex) is crowded / extended — cap size, don't add aggressively.
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（回流与工业资本开支）拥挤／过度拉伸 — 控制仓位，勿激进加仓。

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 上行 · 较200日均线 +40% · 顺势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

extension.label: Extension
extension.gloss: Ran too far above trend — high pullback risk.
extension.gloss_zh: 远高于趋势——回撤风险高。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Business durability — will it survive the hold.
quality.gloss_zh: 业务的持久性——能否撑过持有期。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 4% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -9% · 极端 -18% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
